outline.title: Dawn Relay
outline.logline: Route three early-morning signals through a tiny relay desk before the station opens.
outline.gameLoop: Read the incoming signal and choose one of two routing branches; a correct route advances to the next signal.
outline.ending: The completion Scene reports that all three paths are stable before dawn.

walkthrough:
# Dawn Relay -- Walkthrough

Launch the Project and choose Begin. On Amber choose North. On Blue choose Archive. On Green choose North. Correct choices advance; incorrect choices remain on the current relay. Reaching ALL PATHS STABLE is the win state. The Project uses only menu Scenes and RTP Scene commands; combat, units, items, quests, roles, elements, skills, states and passives are intentionally empty.
